articles.title: Monument Bank delays retail tokenized deposits, cites regulatory issues in the UK
articles.snippet: The London-based challenger bank tapped a Canadian custodian to meet the Financial Conduct Authority’s regulatory requirements. It now expects to roll out retail tokenized deposits by November.

articles.title: MoneyGram unveils stablecoin-backed card as digital dollars move into everyday spending
articles.snippet: The remittance giant is rolling out a Visa card that lets customers hold dollars and spend from a stablecoin-backed balance.

articles.title: Crypto exchange giant Bybit to offer European ‘super-app’ with stocks, derivatives
articles.snippet: Bybit has an electronic money institution license in Austria and is about to snag a MiFID license too, CEO Ben Zhou told Coindesk.

articles.title: MoneyGram launches Visa stablecoin card as remittance rivals expand
articles.snippet: MoneyGram is following rival Western Union’s lead, rolling out a Visa stablecoin debit card as it expands blockchain-based payments.

articles.title: Solana sees record 263K tokens issued in a single day
articles.snippet: Memecoin platform Pump.fun accounted for most of the new tokens among launchpads, as the Solana network notched a new all-time daily issuance high.
